name: landlord-skills
description: AI skills for UK private landlords with one or a few homes: Section 13 rent increases, tenant repair requests and everyday tenant messages under the Renters' Rights Act rules in England. Works in ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Codex, Cursor and more.
